title: Slushie Bar Salts Blackcurrant Watermelon Bubblegum 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blackcurrant Watermelon Bubblegum from Slushie Bar Salts is an imaginative e-liquid that combines the richness of Blackcurrants with the refreshing sweetness of Watermelon, all wrapped up in the nostalgic flavour of Bubblegum. This Nic Salt blend creates a delightful fusion of fruit and candy, offering a unique and enjoyable vaping experience. The e-liquid starts with the deep, dark taste of Blackcurrants, offering a burst of juicy sweetness that's instantly recognisable. This is beautifully balanced with the light, refreshing flavour of Watermelon, adding a summery twist to the blend. The addition of Bubblegum ties these fruit flavours together with a classic, sweet confectionary note, reminiscent of childhood treats. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
